user.title: HuaweiHome Bridge
user.description: For an existing integration, use Configure on its original entry to adopt the same paired gateway. This page creates one HiLink gateway or restores a verified existing pairing.

openharmony.title: Isolated OpenHarmony backend
openharmony.description: Enter the isolated directory relative to HA configuration. No REST token is needed. Prepared executable, profiles, entity mappings and independent pairing files are required. This step validates only.

existing_gateway.title: Existing gateway: lifecycle and engine
existing_gateway.description: Restore one verified existing pairing from a private directory. If the original entry exists, use its Configure page. This does not create a new cloud parent identity.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance of this integration is allowed
abort.already_configured: This backend gateway is already configured.

error.invalid_openharmony_directory: Check the isolated directory, permissions, executable/profile hashes, duplicate gateway/directory and ports.
error.invalid_gateway_directory: Check original entry, gateway identity, catalog, permissions and native programs. No new identity is created.

select_device.title: Device Management
select_device.description: {device_count} device(s) connected. Check to bridge a device, uncheck to remove it.

backend.title: Current bridge instance / enable and disable
backend.description:
Active: {active_backend}; saved: {selected_backend}.
Write policy: {write_policy}.

Disabling OpenHarmony stops only this instance and keeps pairing. Legacy HiLink and other instances keep running. Disabling a resident legacy SDK requires an HA restart. Add a separate entry for another backend type; setup failure never starts another backend.

openharmony.title: Isolated OpenHarmony backend
openharmony.description: Enter the isolated directory relative to HA configuration. No REST token is needed. Prepared executable, profiles, entity mappings and independent pairing files are required. This step validates only.

gateway_lifecycle.title: Existing gateway: lifecycle and engine
gateway_lifecycle.description:
Active: {active_backend}; selected: {selected_backend}; failed: {failed_backend}.

Retains this entry and paired gateway. Prepare and verify the private directory offline first. Failed activation rolls back to the verified engine of this identity. A resident legacy SDK requires an HA restart. Disable/removal retains pairing.

managed_devices.title: Device management
managed_devices.description:
Select HA source devices to bridge ({device_count} candidates).

Unchecking disables bridging and retains paired child cards. It does not turn off physical devices. New devices require role bindings. All devices share this gateway.

managed_role_device.title: Roles and capability cards
managed_role_device.description: Choose a configured device. Original primary light identity and bindings are preserved. Add new devices using Device management first.

managed_layout.title: Fan card layout
managed_layout.description: The six-speed layout uses two four-key cards for six speeds, natural wind and power, avoiding unsupported speed 7/8 and oscillation controls. Existing paired cards are retained offline after a layout change and can be removed manually in Smart Life.

managed_cards.title: Capability cards
managed_cards.description: Choose the required capabilities. The original primary light remains. The full native timer uses a vendor page with additional unmapped controls. Unchecking disables the corresponding capabilities.

managed_roles.title: Bind HA entities
managed_roles.description: Bind roles to distinct entities of the same HA device. The original primary light cannot be rebound. Saving bindings does not operate devices.

managed_confirm.title: Confirm device configuration

progress.wait_for_binding:
Please enter the following PIN code in Huawei Smart Life app to complete binding

### 🔐 PIN Code: **{pin_code}**

⏰ Valid for: **{time_out} minutes**

---

**Binding Steps:**

1.Open Huawei Smart Life app

2.Tap '+' → Add Device

3.Select 'Gateway' → Enter PIN code

4.Input the PIN shown above

5.Wait for binding success

---

**Important Notes:**

-Please complete binding within **{time_out} minutes**

-PIN code expires after timeout, please reconfigure

abort.pin_expired: PIN code has expired, please reconfigure
abort.integration_not_init: Integration is starting up, please try again later
abort.legacy_only: This action is available only for the legacy HiLink backend.
abort.no_managed_roles: No configurable role bindings. Add a device through Device management first.
abort.managed_source_unavailable: The source device is missing or disabled. Restore it or disable bridging through Device management.
abort.managed_update_required: Prepare the gateway directory with the current native build before enabling device management. Existing configuration and engine are retained.

error.invalid_openharmony_directory: Check the isolated directory, permissions, executable/profile hashes, duplicate gateway/directory and ports.
error.invalid_gateway_directory: Check original entry, gateway identity, catalog, permissions and native programs. No new identity is created.
error.invalid_managed_cards: Choose at least one supported card.
error.invalid_managed_roles: Use distinct entities of the same device and preserve the original light. Standard lights require brightness and color temperature; fans must report selected capabilities; effects must be advertised.
error.managed_role_missing: A required entity is missing. Select fewer capability cards or restore the source entities.
error.invalid_managed_plan: Not saved. Check roles, installed profiles and original bindings. Reopen configuration if another flow has saved changes.

notify.restart_message: HuaweiHome Bridge has been removed. If you want to re-add this integration, please restart Home Assistant first, otherwise the integration will not work properly.
